correctness.rationale: Direct kick-drift-kick linear map yields determinant one, trace-2=(x+y)^2(xy-4)/4 and trace+2=(x(x+y)-4)(y(x+y)-4)/4. Elliptic/hyperbolic and Jordan classifications prove the complete necessary-and-sufficient statement. On trace=+2, F12=-(x+y) proves nonidentity. On trace=-2, F=-I iff x=y=sqrt(2). The rational checker ran on the actual standalone package path: 399 exact maps, 1596 checks and 4 rational witnesses. Universal proof relies on exact identities, not finite tests.

value.rationale: The sharp entire positive-pair phase diagram answers the substantive design question whether composing two stable steps remains stable (no) or whether an unstable step necessarily makes a periodic cycle unstable (no), with exact witnesses. The exceptional parabolic point is needed for a correct if-and-only-if theorem. Periodic timestep resonance is known, but its full exact bidirectional classification is a motivated structural fact rather than a routine parameter substitution.
